review_scope: Claim selection and independent recomputation from persisted raw rows and git chronology. This is not external peer review and does not merge research branches.

decisions.safe_claim: Under the fixed residual-MLP/digits/first-two-block replacement protocol and the tested portable_v2_sqrt64 CPU numerical profile, a fresh 16-model-seed cohort selected a smaller composed replacement budget on average while selected test accuracy was noninferior within the prespecified 2 percentage-point margin.
required_caveats: One reused digits dataset split; 16 model seeds are not 16 datasets.
Test metrics do not select replacement budgets, but the test split is reused rather than operationally unseen.
The portable_v2_sqrt64 recipe is a scoped research numerical profile, not a universal CPU/GPU portability theorem.
This is a new confirmatory baseline and does not recover the historical 1200-1207 archive.

decisions.safe_claim: The historical recorded cohort showed the same directional composition-budget pattern, but its exact archived per-seed values and paired statistic have not been reproduced in current environments.
required_caveats: Do not call the old archive exactly reproduced.
Do not silently replace archived values with R87R2 values.
Keep Issue 87 open as historical provenance/reproduction debt.

decisions.safe_claim: On one fixed California Housing split with the same residual-MLP family and a prospectively selected competent teacher, the fresh eight-seed cohort selected smaller composed replacement budgets in 8/8 seeds and preserved selected held-out test R2 within the prespecified noninferiority margin.
required_caveats: One dataset and one fixed split; not eight independent datasets.
Architecture remains residual-MLP, so this is task/dataset external validity rather than architecture universality.
Selected budgets are minima only over the locked finite grid.
No runtime, memory, energy, hardware-speed, LLM, or universal complexity claim follows.

decisions.reason: Composition-budget and selected-utility gates passed, but both preregistered teacher-strength gates were uncertain. Overall decision remains PHASE3B_CONFIRMATORY_UNCERTAIN.

decisions.safe_claim: Within the locked 13-recipe same-architecture grid, training-only five-fold selection found no teacher satisfying the preregistered stability/quality gate; the outer test was not evaluated.
required_caveats: This does not prove that a strong diabetes teacher is impossible.
Do not weaken the gate or expand the recipe grid post hoc and relabel it confirmatory.
Digits and a declared two-block span only.
The runner recorded test metrics for every candidate, so operational test isolation is weaker than R87R2/Phase4.

decisions.reason: Useful mechanism/boundary evidence, including negative results, but not a universal minimum-interface, whole-model reduction, or communication theorem.
C59/C60 are imported Residual-CNN evidence and original C61 outcome remains unresolved; C61R uses a different Residual-MLP architecture and cannot repair original C61.
Retain only measurements actually made; no general RAM, GPU/VRAM, energy, or deployment-device claim.
INVALIDATED_IMPLEMENTATION_BUG; preserve history but never use as positive or negative inferential evidence.

readiness_interpretation.rationale: A scoped announcement can use R87R2 as the current reproducible direct baseline while explicitly preserving the unrecovered historical archive as a separate issue. This is replacement of the headline evidence selection, not retroactive recovery of old values.
remaining_before_issue_13_closure: Integrate the reviewed R87R2 and Phase4 evidence/provenance into a publication-candidate branch without mechanically merging research stacks.
Update README, STATUS, CLAIMS_AND_EVIDENCE, ANNOUNCEMENT_READINESS and CLAIM_POLICY consistently.
Make the executable publication gate validate the new selected baseline rather than requiring historical 1200-1207 exact parity.
Run repository/publication/final-commit CI on the exact candidate head.
Do not claim external peer review or independent external reproduction.
